definitions.gloss: to polish up; to make shine
definitions.explanation: to polish something thoroughly until it shines

definitions.gloss: to refine; to perfect; to hone
definitions.explanation: to improve skills, techniques, or qualities to a high level through effort

examples.english: I polished the floor until it shone.

examples.english: A car polished to a sparkling finish.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). For the result, use the passive: ピカピカ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げられた⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ (to polish, to brush) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to finish): polishing carried through to a finished shine or a high level.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧/⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧/⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げる (sense 1; often with ピカピカ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧)
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧/⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧/⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げる (sense 2)
- ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げる (to polish a piece of writing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: ordinary polishing or brushing (teeth are ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧, never {磨|みが}き{上|あ}げる); the compound stresses the finished result
- ⟦{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げる→鍛え上げる：08247_kitaeageru⟧: building up strength, stamina, or people through hard training

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧ (to finish, to complete)
